instructions_to_main_agent: Design a hybrid web/PWA app. Focus on mobile-first layouts that look native on phones. Prioritize absolute clarity and a trustworthy aesthetic. Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8) except in dense maps/chats. Ensure the SOS button is the dominant UI element on the dashboard.

constraints.icons: Use lucide-react ONLY. DO NOT USE EMOJIS.
constraints.fonts: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto. STRICTLY stick to the defined typography.

fonts.heading: Outfit
fonts.installation: Import from Google Fonts in index.html or app.css

logo_concept.name: thoraHELP
logo_concept.description: A minimalist location pin icon combined with a medical cross in the center. Text 'thora' in lowercase bold, 'HELP' in uppercase. Primary text color: #2563EB, pin color: #DC2626.

typography_rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-tight text-slate-900 font-['Outfit']
typography_rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 font-['Outfit']
typography_rules.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900 font-['Outfit']
typography_rules.small_label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500 font-['IBM_Plex_Sans']

layout_rules.spacing_scale: Use generous padding for landing pages (p-12, p-16). Use dense padding for dashboard and chat (p-4).
layout_rules.mobile_first: Start with single column. It's a PWA so it must feel like a native mobile app. Use a fixed Bottom Nav bar on mobile.
layout_rules.borders: Use subtle 1px borders (border-slate-200) for cards. No heavy shadows. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.

animations.sos_pulse: CSS ping/pulse on an absolute pseudo-element behind the main SOS button for a radiating emergency signal effect.
animations.hover_states: hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 for interactive cards.

landing_page.layout: Hero Section with large value prop. Features Bento Grid. Trust/Map section. App Store download badges in footer.
landing_page.components: Header with Login/Signup, Hero Section, Feature Bento Grid, Footer.

auth.layout: Desktop: Split screen (image on one side, form on other). Mobile: Centered card.
auth.components: Email/password form, 'Continue with Google' button. Shadcn Input, Label, Button.

dashboard.layout: Top bar: Header & Notifications. Dominant UI Element: Massive, highly visible SOS Emergency button at top/center. Middle: Leaflet Map showing current location and pulsing radius for active nearby signals. Bottom: Scrollable feed of active requests.
dashboard.components: MapContainer (React Leaflet), Floating SOS Action Button, Bottom Sheet/Drawer for Feed.

signal_detail_chat.layout: Header with back button and signal status ('Medical Emergency - 150m'). Main area: Scrollable chat thread. Bottom: Input area.
signal_detail_chat.components: WhatsApp-style chat bubbles (right/blue for self, left/white for others). Voice note component: horizontal pill with Play/Pause (lucide-react) and simulated waveform (multiple vertical bars). 'I'm on my way' CTA for responders.

profile.components: Form with Blood Group, Emergency Contacts, Profile Picture update.

hero_map.description: Aerial city map view for landing page feature section.

community_help.description: Community helping hands for onboarding / landing page emotional connection.

avatar_1.description: Profile picture for primary user / responder.

testing.rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='sos-button', data-testid='chat-input-field'). Use kebab-case, role-based naming.
